fields.summary_ko.0: SK Hynix increased U.S. sales by over KRW 102 trillion in the first three quarters of this year, accounting for 62.5% of total sales, with estimated largest customer (NVIDIA) sales more than doubling.
fields.summary_ko.1: Amid stock plunges, individual investors made net purchases of approximately KRW 1.5 trillion in Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix.
